topic.title: Spirograph
topic.description: Creates a colorful spirograph pattern by drawing circles with a small heading change each iteration. Combines loops, geometry, and random color generation.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Drawing circles with turtle.circle() and rotating the heading by a small angle each iteration to create a spirograph effect.
learningNotes.challenges: Finding the right balance between angle increment and number of iterations.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Experiment with different radii, speeds, and angle increments.

files.description: Colorful spirograph pattern with random RGB colors.
